changes: runtime/assert/runner.ts: runAssertion gains an optional progress sink (250ms barrier heartbeats; throwing sinks never fail roots); new runAssertionRoot selects one root via root=<index> argv, streams CAN-PROGRESS records on stderr, prints one can.assertion-root-report on stdout; multi-root runAssertions removed (no other callers).
runtime/assert/context.ts: new contextProgress exposes barrier pending count + frame paths/phases (structural, no values/secrets).
compiler/internal/emit/program.go: assertion entry calls $canRunAssertionRoot with process.argv.slice(2).

compiler/internal/driver/supervise.go (new): RunSupervised runs roots sequentially in stable order under an external monotonic budget; timeout wins at equality; over-budget workers are SIGKILLed outside the worker and reaped within 1000ms; unconfirmed workers stop the suite; crash/protocol failures record the root and continue; progress consumed from stderr, bounded diagnostics forwarded only for undelivered roots.

compiler/internal/driver/assert.go: sort roots, stage privately, supervise, aggregate the suite report (scope/timeoutMs/complete/elapsedMs additive; legacy suite-level initialization-failure shape preserved when every root fails in setup); broken report pipe stays silent exit 1 via SIGPIPE-tolerant encode.
compiler/main.go: assert accepts --assert-timeout-ms 1..600000 (default 5000) before PROJECT; usage exit 2 on invalid/missing values; ErrAssertionsFailed maps to silent exit 1.
